newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 18.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Government gives police modern equipment, including mopeds, to help them boost number of patrols as part of a crack-down on crime and insecurity. - Minister for the Family and Promotion of Women Albertine Gnanazan Hepie briefs non-governmental organisations on government plan to clear street children from Ivory Coast's towns and cities and help reinsert them in society. LE JOUR - Donors agree to help fund 155 billion CFA first phase of Ivory Coast's four-year Environmental Action Plan, which will be managed by a National Environment Agency. The four-year plan will cost a total of 500 billion CFA francs. LE REPUBLICAIN - Customs fraud uncovered at Abidjan airport; two senior administrators suspended. LA VOIE - Three Ivorians take part in world conference for young entrepreneurs in Canada
